why: The enacting act itself, in the Diario da Republica text: the national personal data protection law, which also creates the ANPDP as supervisory authority
The same national law carries the only Sao Tomean rule on transfers of personal data outside the territory; staged once under baseline and topped up with the gov.regional topic

A national statute whose stated object is adapting domestic law to the international conventions on cybercrime, with a full chapter on international cooperation; domestication beats a regional instrument that merely lists the country
In-window step hosted by Sao Tome itself and reported by its own regulator, closing with a joint commitment to regulatory harmonisation among the lusophone countries
The completion record of the project that financed the country participation in the ACE submarine cable and created the STP-Cabo vehicle holding it
Dated in-window status report giving the current position of the inter-island submarine cable procurement, the one shared infrastructure now moving
The ISO member record establishing the country correspondent membership and naming SENAPIQ-STP as the national body
First certification of a bank in the country to an international standard, a dated in-window instance of adoption rather than an intention
The national interoperability framework itself, already staged by a sibling slice; topped up with the gov.standards topic rather than restaged
In-window delivery of an actual interoperability platform joining the civil register and voter registration databases
The national quality body own Portuguese page setting out its statutory nature and its competences in normalisation, certification, accreditation and metrology
The consultation mechanism in operation and reported on by the regulator itself, on a digital policy instrument, rather than the general constitutional right
A fresh in-window public consultation opened on a national digital strategy, with a stated 30 day comment window
Distinct in-window event: a public session putting an electoral digitisation platform and the legal revision it needs to open discussion
The state budget document itself, published by the finance ministry, which is the domestic appropriations instrument the indicator turns on
The enacted 2026 budget law, the single largest in-window movement in domestic financing; already staged by a sibling and topped up rather than restaged
Distinct in-window event setting the 2026 fiscal targets that bound the domestic space for digital spending
The signing party own release recording the elevation of the bilateral relationship to a strategic partnership, not a press account of it
In-window memorandum published by the Sao Tomean signing directorate itself; already staged by a sibling and topped up
